content.text:
The 3 Tech Laggards Are Top Stock Picks, UBS Says
While “buy the dip” isn’t always a prudent strategy, there is perhaps nothing more exhilarating for an investor than picking up a struggling stock just as it rebounds. UBS has some recommendations.
